messages:
incident-bot: :bell: PagerDuty alert: private-agent-conn (P0) — tls handshake failures from multiple on-prem agents in private VPCs detected by control-plane.

pagerduty: INC-19002 triggered at 07:12 UTC; policy: SRE Primary -> SRE Lead -> NetOps.

nina (oncall): I'm taking this. seeing a flurry of TLS errors in control-plane logs for customers delta-llc and gamma-platform. placing bridge. 07:13 UTC

omar (sre): jumping in. control-plane rejects with `tls: handshake failure` for agent client cert CNs from those VPCs. not reporting TCP timeouts. logs: 
```
[2026-04-02T07:11:58Z] controlplane: connection from 10.9.8.21: tls handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
[2026-04-02T07:12:01Z] controlplane: agent-auth failed: client cert expired, serial=0x9af3
```

vivian (sre-lead): that suggests cert expiry or an automated rotation failure. any recent CA changes? check certmgr service and PKI. 07:14 UTC

omar (sre): checking recent CA ops logs: cert-rotation job for agents ran at 06:50 UTC, returned success codes for most customers but with warnings for customers behind strict egress (delta-llc). grabbing rotation logs. 07:15 UTC

lia (netops): netops here. delta-llc reports they applied stricter egress firewall rules last night (only allow TLS to specific ALB IPs). if cert rotation used a different egress hostname/ip we might be hitting firewall deny. 07:16 UTC

cs-bot: Notifying customer delta-llc (oncall@delta.example) and gamma-platform (ops@gamma.example) that we're investigating agent connectivity issues. ETA: 20m. 07:16 UTC

delta-ops (customer): delta-ops: we see failed TLS sessions from agents to controlplane IPs, we've not changed certs on our side. We'll hold for your instructions. 07:17 UTC

omar (sre): reproduced locally against their agent host via bastion:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect controlplane.prod:443 -cert /etc/redwood/agent/cert.pem -key /etc/redwood/agent/key.pem -servername cp.redwood.internal -brief
CONNECTED(00000003)
140736... error:1407A0C1:SSL routines:SSL23_GET_SERVER_HELLO:unknown protocol
---
verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
---
```
Agent cert expiration time: 2026-04-02T06:50:00Z (from cert subject). 07:18 UTC

vivian (sre-lead): confirmed expired client certs on several agent hosts where auto-rotate didn't complete. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/agent-cert-rotation (section: emergency manual rotate).

omar (sre): plan: 1) attempt on-host manual cert refresh for a pilot host, 2) if that works, trigger bulk retry for affected customers, 3) offer hosted-controlplane fallback for customers that allow it.

nina (oncall): do we have an automated emergency cert-sign endpoint? 07:20 UTC

omar (sre): yes, certmgr has an emergency-sign API but it requires mutual auth from our ops PKI key. I'll run manual flow for delta-llc pilot.

omar (sre): manual rotate commands run on delta bastion: 
```
# on delta bastion
sudo systemctl stop redwood-agent
sudo cp /var/run/agent-rotation/new-cert.pem /etc/redwood/agent/cert.pem
sudo cp /var/run/agent-rotation/new-key.pem /etc/redwood/agent/key.pem
sudo systemctl start redwood-agent
sudo journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 30 --no-pager
```

omar (sre): after manual update, agent reconnected successfully and control-plane accepted handshake. controlplane logs show auth success for that host. 07:24 UTC

lia (netops): note: delta-llc egress rules block outbound to our certmgr IP (34.198.12.9) during rotation window — explains why auto-rotate failed. netops can propose two mitigations: 1) request customer open short-lived exception to certmgr IPs, or 2) sign new batch of certs on our side and deliver via support channel for manual install. 07:25 UTC

cs-bot: delta-llc responded: "we cannot open exceptions due to compliance. please provide signed certs for our ops to install manually." 07:26 UTC

vivian (sre-lead): OK. for compliance-bound customers we must support out-of-band cert delivery. action items: omar to generate signed cert blobs for delta-llc; cs to coordinate with delta ops for manual install; netops to document mitigation for future rotations (fallback to signed artifact delivery). 07:27 UTC

omar (sre): generating signed certs for delta and gamma now via certmgr emergency-sign API and storing artifacts in secure artifact store. commands: 
```
# certmgr client
certmgr sign --customer delta-llc --ttl 90d --out /secure/artifacts/delta-certs.tar.gz --auth-token $PM_KEY
```

omar (sre): uploaded artifact to /incidents/INC-19002/delta-certs.tar.gz and notified CS. 07:30 UTC

cs-bot: Delivered artifact link to delta-llc ops with instructions for install and md5 checksum. Requested confirmation when installed. 07:31 UTC

delta-ops (customer): installing now, will report back. 07:32 UTC

vivian (sre-lead): customer-impact summary: delta-llc & gamma-platform — agent traffic failing auth; inference control-plane operations degraded for those private deployments, ~70% failure rate for control RPCs since 07:11 UTC. hosted fallback not permitted by delta-llc. recommend marking incident severity customer-impacting. 07:33 UTC

nina (oncall): updating PagerDuty notes and incident severity. 07:34 UTC

omar (sre): gamma-platform allowed hosted fallback; enabled fallback toggle for gamma-platform to reduce customer outage while their ops apply certs. command: 
```
redwoodctl customers set-fallback gamma-platform --to hosted-controlplane --ttl 45m --reason "agent cert rotation failure"
```

omar (sre): gamma errors drop to normal within 3 minutes. 07:38 UTC

cs-bot: delta-llc confirms manual install complete on pilot host and reports restored connectivity for that node. they will roll out to remaining hosts on a maintenance window; provided schedule: immediate rollout over 2 hours. 07:40 UTC

lia (netops): creating follow-up to update our rotation process: add signed-artifact fallback, detect egress-restricted customers in rotation plan, and pre-seed certs before rotation windows. assigning to PKI and NetOps owners. 07:42 UTC

vivian (sre-lead): summary/resolution plan:
- Root cause: automated cert rotation failed for customers with restrictive egress (blocked access to certmgr endpoints) -> agents presented expired certs -> control-plane rejected TLS handshakes.
- Short-term mitigations: manual cert refresh for pilots; emergency signed-artifact delivery; hosted fallback for willing customers.
- Long-term actions: rotation runbook updated, certmgr retry/backoff improvements, pre-bake signed artifacts for egress-restricted customers.
- Customer communication: CS has coordinated with delta-llc and gamma-platform.

nina (oncall): incident status -> Mitigated (partial) at 07:43 UTC. follow-ups created: INC-19002-FU-1 (PKI runbook), INC-19002-FU-2 (support artifact workflow). Next update in 30m or on customer confirmation. 07:44 UTC

omar (sre): attaching logs, rotation diagnostics, and signed artifact link to incident. I'll monitor for 1 hour and then hand off. 07:45 UTC

delta-ops (customer): thanks team, we'll confirm when full fleet done. 07:46 UTC

-- end of thread --
